# Contributing to ui-muyu

完整规范见 [`docs/development/standards.md`](docs/development/standards.md)。

## Branches and scope

- Make changes on a development branch such as `codex/*` or `development`.
- Keep `main` release-ready. Do not develop directly on `main`.
- Before merging, rebase or merge the current `main`, run the full checks, and leave the worktree clean.
- Keep DSH compatibility changes, UI behavior changes, generated artifacts, and their documentation in the same reviewable change.

## Source and generated files

- TypeScript and CSS source lives under `src/` and `shared/`.
- `lib/` is generated by `pnpm build`; do not hand-edit generated JavaScript, source maps, or declarations.
- When a source change affects the client bundle, regenerate `lib/` and verify the generated output is included in the change.
- `docs/images/preview.png` is the protected visual reference. UI changes must preserve the README/main silhouette unless the product requirement explicitly changes it.

## UI rules

- The widget renders through the host React and `createPortal` into one open Shadow Root. Do not create a second React root.
- Keep the complete widget stylesheet inside that Shadow Root. Do not inject plugin styles into `document.head` and do not use `:global()` to escape the boundary.
- DSH tokens may provide theme colors. Geometry, dimensions, borders, shadows, animation timing, and control layout belong to the plugin.
- The fish keeps the README/main lightly irregular outline. The mallet stays mounted and animates on a strike; the fish itself does not move.

## Privacy and data

- The plugin makes no network requests and does not read credentials, files, shell state, sessions, or conversations.
- `localStorage` is the only persistence mechanism, using the documented `dsh-muyu.state.v1` record.
- New permissions, storage fields, or host APIs require an explicit documentation update and review.

## Verification

Run these commands before opening a pull request:

```sh
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm pack:check
pnpm release:check
git diff --check
```

`pnpm test` builds the real client bundle before running Vitest. Browser and Desktop checks must use an isolated `DSH_HOME`; never use the user's real DSH profile for plugin validation.

## Release metadata

- Bump `package.json` and `registry/curated/plugin.json` together.
- Keep the registry tag and release tarball path aligned with the package version.
- Update the dated handoff/test report when the supported DSH version or user-visible behavior changes.
- Do not publish until the Web/Desktop verification status, theme behavior, uninstall/reload behavior, and hostile-host-style isolation checks are recorded.

## Release process

- Create a `codex/release-vX.Y.Z` branch from the latest green `main`; never bump versions, create tags, or publish directly from an unreviewed `main` change.
- Run the full local gate before opening the release PR: `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm pack:check`, `pnpm release:check`, and `git diff --check`.
- Merge only after every PR check passes. If CI is red, stop the release and fix the cause through a new reviewed commit.
- After merge, tag the exact `main` HEAD, create the GitHub Release from that tag, and upload the tarball built from the same commit.
- Verify that the tag, `main`, Release asset, registry metadata, and tag-push CI all refer to the same version and commit.
- A fix to bundle determinism or another published artifact requires an immediate patch release after it reaches `main`.

The historical audit and rationale are recorded in [`docs/development/release-process-review-2026-10-27.md`](docs/development/release-process-review-2026-10-27.md).

## Test artifacts and documentation

- Keep reproducible harness source under `e2e/` when it is useful to future maintainers.
- Generated harness output belongs in `e2e/dist/` and is ignored.
- Local browser screenshots belong in `gui-test-screenshots/` and are ignored unless a specific report requires a committed image.
- Historical review reports remain dated records. Update the current status in `docs/development/ui-isolation.md` and the latest handoff section instead of rewriting old findings.
